chunks: (Do you think) you will be left secure here

key_terms.تُتْرَكُونَ: you will be left/allowed to remain

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Are you left secure here?' in Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this rhetorical question challenges the disbelievers' false sense of security, emphasizing that their current state is not one of true safety but of impending divine reckoning. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a warning against complacency in faith, urging believers to remain vigilant against the deceptive calm of worldly life before the Day of Judgment.
